name: nostalgia
description: Pleasant memories of the past along with a sense of sadness that the object is no longer attainable.

variations.name: cohort bonding
variations.description: Nostalgia can be a generational group bond with others who share the memories.

commentaries.quote: Similar to wistfulness except nostalgia at least has the consoloation of pleasant memories.
Nostalgic memories benefit from having left behind the anxieties of that moment.
It is sadder to find the past again and find it inadequate to the present than it is to have it elude you and remain forever a harmonious conception of memory.

conditions: A longing to experience something again that's no longer possible.
